title: Who Licks the Cake?
lines: Mom and Jane bake a big cake.
They set the plate on a big flat rock.
Jane runs back. The big cake has a lick!
Cake is on the chin of Jake the cat!
"We can make a small cake," said Jane.
They bake it, and Jake laps it up.
Then they take the big cake in.

questions.ask: Where did Mom and Jane put the big cake?
questions.listenFor: On a plate on a big flat rock outside. Line two says it. Let your child reread rather than being told.

questions.ask: How did Jane work out who licked the cake?
questions.listenFor: There was cake on Jake the cat's chin. Line five says it. This is the reveal, so it is worth a little talk.

questions.ask: What do you think Jake will do next? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any guess is fine if it has a reason from the story, like "go back to the rock, because that is where the cake was."
